behavior: Check is default; explicit --apply stages only versioned kernel package, matching PVR and initrd.
No candidate-selection function, default symlink replacement, reboot, bootcmd, SPL, GPT or raw block-device writes.
Fixed final combined VE400/DCDC2-readback artifacts, package control and complete payload manifests verified. Maintainer scripts read in full: only scoped run-parts under suppressed hook roots.

Private mount namespace suppresses package/kernel/initramfs post-update hooks; all existing noncandidate boot objects, v16/v27 module and DTB trees, package metadata, initramfs state and generic kernel links are journaled.
Default v16 kernel/config/System.map/DTB and accepted v27 kernel/config/System.map/DTB/PVR checked against fixed hashes before staging.
Successful staging rechecks protected snapshots and reports STAGED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_BOOT_TESTED; candidate paths supplied for a separately operated one-shot boot.
Failures restore journaled protected bytes only after writer process groups have stopped; unconfirmed termination explicitly blocks rollback.
Saved bounded protected-root list allows recovery of missing boot files; directory leaf symlinks are unlinked before restoring a directory and symlink parent chains are rejected.

checks: parent rc0 descendant stopped before rollback
parent rc1 descendant stopped before rollback
timeout command stopped and original error propagated
directory leaf symlink restored without following
deleted protected boot file accepted for recovery
deleted protected boot file restored exactly

review_repairs: Detected child writer groups even when the parent returns after closing captured pipes.
Used saved bounded roots and fixed required paths for missing-file rollback, rather than live directory enumeration.
Prevented directory restoration through symlink leaves/parents.
Moved missing-build-binding guard before all check/apply/rollback entry points.
limits: No board check/apply/rollback/reboot performed by these reviewers.
Host rollback test uses a temporary filesystem and simulates root ownership of its private journal directory; real board identity/storage and private mount operation remain runtime checks.
Stage failure may retain versioned candidate files for diagnosis; it does not uninstall or select the candidate.
The package remains a hardware candidate; this audit proves neither VE400 runtime voltage/clock state nor 1080p60 performance.
